description: Up to ten cards to add to a Commander decklist, ranked, each with the reason, built toward a bracket when one is given.

bracket.description: The bracket to build toward; the deck's own when absent.

decklist.description: One card per line (`1 Sol Ring`), at most 250 distinct cards and 20,000 characters. A `Commander` heading or `*CMDR*` marks the commanders.
